reproduce.version_requirement: Reproduce the reported 0.102.2933 Store upgrade path on two physical test PCs; compare current stable/main migration behavior.
prerequisites: Use an isolated test account or controlled test machine; preserve existing user data.
steps: 1. Pair two physical test PCs with matched versions, elevated Settings and service mode already on; preserve private configuration backups without exposing keys.
2. Upgrade one supported version transition without toggling service mode or editing a key; record file/key-presence/mode metadata and worker/service identity before and after.
3. Compare a documented first-time storage migration with a second upgrade using already-migrated state; distinguish a preserved key from a non-running service.
4. Restart/reconnect and separately exercise the existing legacy typed-key fix path only if that path is involved.
reproduce.expected_result: Unchanged supported service-mode upgrades preserve usable pairing; one-time incompatible-mode transitions are explicit, and service startup errors do not silently erase configuration.
